name: Eq

sections.heading: Origin and explicit import
sections.text: Implicit origin: PRELUDE. Original module: std.core. Explicit alternative: import "std.core" { Eq; }.explicit; --no-prelude removes implicit visibility. Import every referenced prelude name explicitly; imports grant no capability.

sections.heading: Behavior, methods and protocols
sections.text: Equal values agree under the admitted equality owner. Hash + Eq is the measured dictionary/generic constraint profile; names alone do not supply arbitrary user implementations.

sections.heading: Ownership and effects
sections.text: No capability grant. The receiver type determines copy and lifetime behavior; comparing values does not transfer ownership.

sections.heading: Errors and limits
sections.text: Incompatible generic arguments and malformed constraints reject. An Eq import is visibility, not a new operator implementation.
